text.card: A red giant 4,956 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 1.36 solar masses and 11.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,679 K at its surface.
